target: Meme Lab public 3,000-reference playground with responsive doodle layer

customReplacement.reason: The product-defining blind A/B review has no matching generic block, and adding a runtime UI dependency solely for this plain-JS local experiment would weaken the stack.

contract.purpose: Turn one pasted comment or situation into a useful meme immediately without forcing a joke.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Meme Lab turns one pasted comment or situation into a useful meme immediately.
contract.audience: The owner first, with a public playground for lightweight feedback.
contract.job: Paste one complete comment, see the best meme and four ranked backups across useful viewpoints, then record whether the result landed; read the full evidence-backed project journey when needed.
contract.thesis: A crisp white working canvas with pale-blue navigation, mint and yellow state landmarks, restrained borders, and colorful hand-drawn reaction marks around the working area.
contract.system: Clean Canvas keeps its lightweight workspace rail and compact task flow, while a fixed edge-only doodle field adds meme-native personality without entering controls or result cards.
contract.signature: A best-match result with four viewpoint-aware alternatives, surrounded by reaction bursts, speech bubbles, stars, arrows, hearts, and a hand-drawn 3K mark.
contract.risk: The intentionally abundant doodles must remain decorative, non-interactive, and subordinate to the comment form, result hierarchy, and long-form reading experience.

projectCheck.command: npm test && npm run check && node /Users/sarthak/Desktop/fleet/saas-maker/tooling/scripts/design-workflow.mjs check --project /Users/sarthak/Downloads/meme_lab
